newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: KLZ says units expect mixed 1997/98 year.
newsitem.headline: KLZ says units expect mixed 1997/98 year.

text.p: KLZ Ltd, formerly Kalamazoo Holdings, said on Tuesday it expected a mixed outlook for the 1997/98 year from its three core businesses -- building products, printing and electrical unit.
Earlier, KLZ reported a 8.7 percent rise in net profit to A$12.83 million for the year to June 30, 1997.

For the electrical unit, KLZ said the outlook for 1997/98 was for double digit earnings growth driven by continued growth in Arlec consumer products and a better performance from the electronic components as the market continues its recovery.
